_readme: Field Radio playlist. Drop your PLC voice notes (.m4a/.mp3/.wav) and shorts (.mp4) into /assets/field-radio/, then add an entry below. type: 'audio' for voice notes, 'video' for shorts. 'src' is the file path; 'poster' (video only) is an optional still image. 'transcript' powers the caption panel (accessibility + SEO) — keep it, even a short paraphrase helps. 'track' colour-codes the clip by learning track. The three sample-note entries are placeholder tones so the dial works before you upload — delete them once you add real clips.

station.name: Field Radio
station.tagline: Voices from the ImpactMojo Practitioner Learning Community — press play and listen in.

clips.title: Sample tone — replace with a voice note
clips.speaker: Field Radio
clips.transcript: This is a placeholder tone so you can hear the station play and auto-advance. Drop a real PLC voice note into /assets/field-radio/ and replace this entry — the transcript you paste here becomes the caption below the dial.

clips.title: Sample tone — the dial auto-advances
clips.speaker: Field Radio
clips.transcript: When one clip ends, the next begins — that is what makes it a station rather than a playlist. Use the skip controls to move between voices, or tap any clip in the list to jump straight to it.

clips.title: Sample tone — filter by track
clips.speaker: Field Radio
clips.transcript: Each clip is tagged by learning track, so listeners can tune the station to what they care about. Add a 'video' clip with a .mp4 and it will play in a vertical frame instead of the cassette.

clips.title: Sample short — replace with a reel
clips.speaker: Field Radio
clips.transcript: A vertical short (.mp4) renders in a 9:16 phone frame instead of the cassette, plays inline, and auto-advances like the voice notes. This entry has no file yet, so it shows a gentle "Short coming soon" — drop a real reel at the src path to light it up.
